exceptions.rationale: Proposed seven-day acceptance requiring explicit human review for production and DEV/QLTY validation of Spring 5.3.39 on the javax-compatible Core/OMOD stack. Correct fixable OS and Guava findings first; other findings remain blocking. Remove when a compatible maintained Core/framework release passes native, authentication and module tests; track migration in issue #323.
